response.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG((CAST(g AS REAL) - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), compared AS (SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS wins_above_mean FROM compared WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins ORDER BY wins_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_half row contributes one observation to a team's averages; the comparison mean gives each team equal weight. A zero-loss row has an undefined ratio and is excluded from that average.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each team, year, and half as one observation by summing its managers' records before calculating team averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH team_halves AS (SELECT team_id, year, league_id, half, SUM(w) AS wins, SUM(l) AS losses, SUM(g) AS games FROM manager_half WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id, year, league_id, half), team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins, AVG((CAST(games AS REAL) - losses) / NULLIF(losses, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM team_halves GROUP BY team_id), compared AS (SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS wins_above_mean FROM compared WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins ORDER BY wins_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
